-- Temporarily sync into ServerScriptService. Module/controller remain inert without this fixture.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
if not RunService:IsStudio() then return end
local Test = game:GetService("StudioTestService")
local _, args = pcall(function() return Test:GetTestArgs() end)
local automated = type(args) == "table" and args.test == "F2Physics"
if not automated and workspace:GetAttribute("F2PhysicsStudy") ~= true then return end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Study = require(Storage:WaitForChild("F2PhysicsStudy", 10))
local Config = require(Storage.F1Config)
local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
remote.Name = "F2Study"
remote.Parent = Storage
local ready, pings, lastRequest, lastReport = {}, {}, {}, {}
local active = {}
local reports = {}
local results = {}
local nextId = 0
local rejectedRequests = 0
local wall = nil
local connection

local function finishState(player, reason)
	local state = active[player]
	if not state then return end
	active[player] = nil
	if state.root.Parent then
		state.root:SetAttribute("F2StudyMode", nil)
		state.root:SetAttribute("F2StudyMotorEnabled", nil)
		state.root:SetAttribute("F2StudyInput", nil)
		state.root:SetAttribute("F2StudyJump", nil)
		state.humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine = state.motorEnabled
		if state.motorEnabled and state.humanoid.Health > 0 then state.humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall) end
		if not state.root.Anchored then state.root:SetNetworkOwnershipAuto() end
	end
	state.result.release = reason
	state.result.releaseTime = os.clock() - state.started
end

local function beginState(player, mode, probe, launch)
	finishState(player, "replaced")
	local character = player.Character
	assert(character, "F2 launch requires a current character")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	assert(root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0, "F2 launch requires a living character and root")
	local canOwn, why = root:CanSetNetworkOwnership()
	assert(canOwn, "F2 cannot change character ownership: " .. tostring(why))
	nextId += 1
	local result = { id = nextId, player = player.Name, mode = mode, probe = probe, server = {}, corrections = 0,
		resistance = false, owners = {}, rttMs = pings[player] and pings[player].rtt or -1,
		startedAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), origin = { root.Position.X, root.Position.Y, root.Position.Z },
		minimumFlight = if automated then args.minimumFlight or Study.MinimumFlight else Study.MinimumFlight }
	local state = { character = character, root = root, humanoid = humanoid, mode = mode, result = result,
		started = os.clock(), sampled = -1, origin = root.Position, lastPosition = root.Position, safe = root.CFrame,
		credit = 50 * Study.BurstSeconds + Study.PositionSlack, motorEnabled = humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine,
		launch = launch, probe = probe, displaced = launch ~= nil }
	state.appliedAt = if mode == "server" then state.started else nil
	active[player] = state
	root:SetAttribute("F2StudyMotorEnabled", state.motorEnabled)
	root:SetAttribute("F2StudyInput", if probe == "manual" then nil elseif probe == "reverse" then -Vector3.xAxis elseif probe == "walk" then Vector3.xAxis else Vector3.zero)
	root:SetAttribute("F2StudyMode", if launch then mode else nil)
	root:SetNetworkOwner(if launch and mode == "server" then nil else player)
	remote:FireAllClients("begin", { id = nextId, character = character, probe = probe })
	if launch then
		humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = launch
		result.initial = { root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z }
		if mode == "client" then
			remote:FireClient(player, "launch", { id = nextId, character = character, velocity = launch })
		end
	end
	return result
end

local function sequence(value, count)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then return false end
	local seen = 0
	for key in value do
		seen += 1
		if seen > count or type(key) ~= "number" or key % 1 ~= 0 or key < 1 or key > count then return false end
	end
	return seen == count
end

local function validReport(data)
	if type(data) ~= "table" or type(data.id) ~= "number" or not Study.finite(data.id)
		or type(data.samples) ~= "table" or #data.samples == 0 or #data.samples > 40
		or not sequence(data.samples, #data.samples) then return false end
	for _, sample in data.samples do
		if not sequence(sample, 10) then return false end
		for _, value in sample do
			if type(value) ~= "number" or not Study.finite(value) then return false end
		end
	end
	if data.initial ~= nil then
		if not sequence(data.initial, 3) then return false end
		for _, value in data.initial do
			if type(value) ~= "number" or not Study.finite(value) then return false end
		end
	end
	return true
end

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, command, data)
	if command == "ready" then
		ready[player] = true
	elseif command == "pong" then
		local ping = pings[player]
		if ping and data == ping.id and not ping.rtt then ping.rtt = (os.clock() - ping.sent) * 1000 end
	elseif command == "applied" then
		local state = active[player]
		if state and state.mode == "client" and data == state.result.id and not state.appliedAt then
			state.appliedAt = os.clock()
			state.result.launchAckSeconds = state.appliedAt - state.started
		end
	elseif command == "steer" then
		local state = active[player]
		if not automated and state and state.mode == "server" and os.clock() - (state.lastSteer or 0) >= 0.05
			and Study.vector(data) and data.Y == 0 and data.Magnitude <= 1.001 then
			state.input, state.lastSteer = data, os.clock()
		end
	elseif command == "report" then
		if type(data) ~= "table" or not reports[data.id] or lastReport[player] == data.id or not validReport(data) then return end
		lastReport[player] = data.id
		reports[data.id][player.Name] = { samples = data.samples, initial = data.initial, motorEnabled = data.motorEnabled == true,
			humanoidState = if type(data.humanoidState) == "string" then data.humanoidState:sub(1, 32) else nil }
	elseif command == "request" then
		local now = os.clock()
		if automated or not Study.request(data, now - (lastRequest[player] or -math.huge)) then
			rejectedRequests += 1
			return
		end
		lastRequest[player] = now
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or active[player] then return end
		local direction = Study.horizontal(root.CFrame.LookVector)
		if not Study.vector(direction) or direction.Magnitude < 0.9 then return end
		local result = beginState(player, data, "manual", -direction.Unit * 50 + Vector3.new(0, 12, 0))
		reports[result.id] = {}
		task.delay(1.5, function()
			if active[player] and active[player].result == result then finishState(player, "fixture-timeout") end
			remote:FireAllClients("finish", result.id)
			print("F2 manual result", game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(result))
			reports[result.id] = nil
		end)
	end
end)

connection = RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt)
	for player, state in active do
		local root, humanoid = state.root, state.humanoid
		if player.Character ~= state.character or not root.Parent or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			finishState(player, "character-replaced")
			continue
		end
		local elapsed = os.clock() - state.started
		local position, velocity = root.Position, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local speed = if state.launch then 50 + Study.SteeringAcceleration * elapsed else Config.WalkSpeed
		local invalid = not Study.vector(position) or not Study.vector(velocity)
		local distance = if invalid then math.huge else Study.horizontal(position - state.lastPosition).Magnitude
		local exceeded
		state.credit, exceeded = Study.budget(state.credit, distance, dt, speed)
		state.result.minimumCredit = math.min(state.result.minimumCredit or math.huge, state.credit)
		if invalid or exceeded then
			state.result.corrections += 1
			root:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
			root.CFrame = state.safe
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			position, velocity = root.Position, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			state.credit = speed * Study.BurstSeconds + Study.PositionSlack
			warn("F2 movement corrected", player.Name, state.result.id, if invalid then "nonfinite" else "horizontal-budget")
		else
			state.safe = root.CFrame
		end
		state.lastPosition = root.Position
		-- shortcut: resistance is diagnostic only; collisions can also stop launches, so never punish it automatically.
		if state.probe == "resist" and elapsed >= 0.2 and Study.horizontal(position - state.origin).Magnitude < 2 then
			state.result.resistance = true
		end
		if elapsed - state.sampled >= 0.05 then
			state.sampled = elapsed
			local owner = root:GetNetworkOwner()
			local name = if owner then owner.Name else "server"
			if state.result.owners[#state.result.owners] ~= name then table.insert(state.result.owners, name) end
			table.insert(state.result.server, { elapsed, position.X, position.Y, position.Z, velocity.X, velocity.Y, velocity.Z })
		end
		if state.displaced then
			if state.appliedAt and Study.horizontal(position - state.origin).Magnitude >= 0.5 then
				state.motionObserved = true
				state.result.motionObservedAt = state.result.motionObservedAt or elapsed
			end
			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { state.character }
			params.RespectCanCollide = true
			local ground = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -(humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2 + 0.3), 0), params)
			local grounded = ground ~= nil and velocity.Y <= 0
			if state.motionObserved and os.clock() - state.appliedAt >= state.result.minimumFlight
				and Study.recovered(os.clock() - state.appliedAt, velocity, grounded) then
				state.result.recovery = { at = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),
					position = { position.X, position.Y, position.Z }, velocity = { velocity.X, velocity.Y, velocity.Z },
					groundDistance = if ground then ground.Distance else nil, rayLength = humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2 + 0.3 }
				state.displaced = false
				root:SetAttribute("F2StudyMode", nil)
				humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine = state.motorEnabled
				humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
				root:SetNetworkOwner(player)
				state.result.recoveredAt = elapsed
			elseif state.mode == "server" then
				humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
				local direction = state.input or root:GetAttribute("F2StudyInput")
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Study.steer(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity, if Study.vector(direction) then direction else Vector3.zero, dt)
			end
		end
	end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	finishState(player, "departed")
	ready[player], pings[player], lastRequest[player], lastReport[player] = nil, nil, nil, nil
end)

if not automated then
	print("F2 physics fixture: K switches ownership; L launches yourself backward. No combat is enabled.")
	return
end

local timeout = task.delay(180, function() Test:EndTest({ passed = false, error = "F2 study timed out" }) end)
local passed, failure = pcall(function()
	local deadline = os.clock() + 25
	local players
	repeat
		players = Players:GetPlayers()
		local count = 0
		for _, player in players do if ready[player] and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then count += 1 end end
		if #players == 2 and count == 2 then break end
		task.wait(0.1)
	until os.clock() > deadline
	assert(#players == 2 and ready[players[1]] and ready[players[2]], "F2 needs two ready clients with controllers")
	table.sort(players, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
	if args.awaitNetwork then
		workspace:SetAttribute("F2StudyWaitingNetwork", true)
		local networkDeadline = os.clock() + 45
		repeat task.wait(0.1) until workspace:GetAttribute("F2StudyNetworkReady") == true or os.clock() > networkDeadline
		assert(workspace:GetAttribute("F2StudyNetworkReady") == true, "F2 network profile must be configured in the test process before trials")
	end
	task.wait(2)
	for _, player in players do
		pings[player] = { id = player.UserId, sent = os.clock() }
		remote:FireClient(player, "ping", player.UserId)
	end
	task.wait(1)
	for _, player in players do remote:FireClient(player, "invalid-requests") end
	task.wait(0.3)
	assert(rejectedRequests == 6, "F2 automated mode must reject all untrusted launch requests")
	local probes = args.probes or { "idle", "walk", "jump", "reverse", "airborne", "wall", "resist", "teleport", "speed", "relaunch", "replacement" }
	for _, player in players do
		for _, mode in { "client", "server" } do
			for _, probe in probes do
				for _ = 1, (args.repeats or 1) do
					local root = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
					root:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
					root.Anchored = true
					player.Character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(-12, if probe == "airborne" then 51 else 45, 0))
					root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					if probe == "wall" then
						wall = Instance.new("Part")
						wall.Name, wall.Size, wall.CFrame, wall.Anchored = "F2StudyWall", Vector3.new(1, 20, 20), CFrame.new(-4, 48, 0), true
						wall.Parent = workspace
					end
					root.Anchored = false
					root:SetNetworkOwner(player)
					pings[player] = { id = nextId + 1, sent = os.clock() }
					remote:FireClient(player, "ping", nextId + 1)
					task.wait(0.3)
					local launch = if probe == "teleport" or probe == "speed" or probe == "jump" or probe == "walk" then nil else Study.Launch
					local result = beginState(player, mode, probe, launch)
					active[player].origin = root.Position
					root:SetAttribute("F2StudyJump", probe == "jump")
					reports[result.id] = {}
					task.wait(0.12)
					root:SetAttribute("F2StudyJump", nil)
					if probe == "relaunch" then
						local first = result
						result = beginState(player, mode, probe, -Vector3.xAxis * 50 + Vector3.yAxis * 12)
						assert(first.release == "replaced", "A replacement launch must clean up the prior displacement")
						reports[first.id] = nil
						reports[result.id] = {}
						result.previousLaunch = first.initial
					elseif probe == "replacement" then
						local previous = player.Character
						previous.Humanoid.Health = 0
						task.wait(0.1)
						assert(active[player] == nil and previous.Humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine, "Character death must restore the motor and release study state")
						local untilRespawn = os.clock() + Players.RespawnTime + 5
						repeat task.wait(0.1) until player.Character ~= previous or os.clock() > untilRespawn
						assert(player.Character ~= previous, "F1 must replace the dead study character")
					end
					task.wait(1.08)
					finishState(player, "trial-end")
					task.wait(0.2)
					remote:FireAllClients("finish", result.id)
					task.wait(0.3)
					result.clients = reports[result.id]
					reports[result.id] = nil
					table.insert(results, result)
					if wall then wall:Destroy() wall = nil end
					assert(#result.server > 0, "F2 trial must record server samples")
					assert(result.clients[players[1].Name] and result.clients[players[2].Name], "F2 trial must record subject and observer samples")
					result.checks = {}
					if probe ~= "replacement" then result.checks.motorRestored = result.clients[player.Name].motorEnabled end
					if probe == "teleport" or probe == "speed" then
						result.checks.detected = result.corrections > 0
					else
						result.checks.noFalseCorrection = result.corrections == 0
					end
					local first = result.server[1]
					local travel, rise = 0, 0
					for _, sample in result.server do
						travel = math.max(travel, math.abs(sample[2] - first[2]))
						rise = math.max(rise, sample[3] - first[3])
					end
					result.maxTravel, result.maxRise = travel, rise
					if probe == "jump" then result.checks.jumped = rise > 3 end
					if probe == "walk" then result.checks.walked = travel > 8 end
					if probe == "idle" or probe == "reverse" or probe == "airborne" then result.checks.launched = travel > 2 end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)
task.cancel(timeout)
for player in active do finishState(player, "cleanup") end
connection:Disconnect()
if wall then wall:Destroy() end
remote:Destroy()
local checksPassed = true
for _, result in results do
	for _, check in result.checks or {} do checksPassed = checksPassed and check end
end
Test:EndTest({ passed = passed, error = if passed then nil else tostring(failure), trials = results,
	rejectedRequests = rejectedRequests, behaviorChecksPassed = checksPassed, architectureApproved = false })
tests/F2PhysicsStudy.client.luau:
-- Temporarily sync as a LocalScript in StarterPlayerScripts. Never runs outside Studio.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
if not RunService:IsStudio() then return end
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Input = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local remote = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("F2Study", 20)
if not remote then return end
local trial = nil
local manualMode = "client"
local lastSteer = 0

remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(command, data)
	if command == "ping" then
		remote:FireServer("pong", data)
	elseif command == "begin" then
		trial = { id = data.id, character = data.character, started = os.clock(), samples = {}, lastSample = -1,
			probe = data.probe, subject = data.character == player.Character, applied = false }
	elseif command == "launch" then
		if data.character ~= player.Character then return end
		local root = data.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local humanoid = data.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if root and humanoid then
			humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = data.velocity
			remote:FireServer("applied", data.id)
			if trial and trial.id == data.id then
				trial.applied = true
				trial.initial = { root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z }
			end
		end
	elseif command == "invalid-requests" then
		remote:FireServer("request", {})
		remote:FireServer("request", "unknown")
		remote:FireServer("request", "client")
	elseif command == "finish" and trial and trial.id == data then
		local humanoid = trial.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		remote:FireServer("report", { id = trial.id, samples = trial.samples, initial = trial.initial,
			motorEnabled = humanoid and humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine,
			humanoidState = humanoid and humanoid:GetState().Name })
		trial = nil
	end
end)

RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function()
	if not trial or not trial.subject then return end
	local root = trial.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end
	local elapsed = os.clock() - trial.started
	if trial.probe == "resist" and elapsed > 0.02 then
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	elseif trial.probe == "teleport" and elapsed > 0.25 and not trial.probed then
		root.CFrame += Vector3.new(100, 0, 0)
		trial.probed = true
	elseif trial.probe == "speed" and elapsed > 0.25 then
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(64, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
	end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if root and humanoid and root:GetAttribute("F2StudyMode") == "server" and os.clock() - lastSteer >= 0.1 then
		lastSteer = os.clock()
		remote:FireServer("steer", humanoid.MoveDirection)
	end
	if not trial or #trial.samples >= 40 then return end
	local root = trial.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local elapsed = os.clock() - trial.started
	if root and elapsed - trial.lastSample >= 0.05 then
		trial.lastSample = elapsed
		local p, v = root.Position, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local humanoid = trial.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local mode = root:GetAttribute("F2StudyMode")
		table.insert(trial.samples, { elapsed, p.X, p.Y, p.Z, v.X, v.Y, v.Z,
			workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), if humanoid and humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine then 1 else 0,
			if mode == "client" then 1 elseif mode == "server" then 2 else 0 })
	end
end)

Input.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed or Input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.K then
		manualMode = if manualMode == "client" then "server" else "client"
		print("F2 study ownership:", manualMode)
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.L then
		remote:FireServer("request", manualMode)
	end
end)
remote:FireServer("ready")
--!strict

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Input = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Actions = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local configInstance = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("F1Config", 10)
local movementInstance = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("F1Movement", 10)
assert(configInstance and configInstance:IsA("ModuleScript"), "F1Config is missing")
assert(movementInstance and movementInstance:IsA("ModuleScript"), "F1Movement is missing")
local Config = require(configInstance)
local Movement = require(movementInstance)
local studyInstance = if RunService:IsStudio() then ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("F2PhysicsStudy", 10) else nil
assert(not RunService:IsStudio() or (studyInstance and studyInstance:IsA("ModuleScript")), "F2PhysicsStudy module is missing from the Studio prototype")
local PhysicsStudy = if studyInstance then require(studyInstance) else nil
local playerScripts = player:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts", 10)
assert(playerScripts, "PlayerScripts is missing")
local playerModule = playerScripts:WaitForChild("PlayerModule", 10)
assert(playerModule and playerModule:IsA("ModuleScript"), "Default PlayerModule is missing")
-- Scriptable movement alone does not stop every default jump controller.
local defaultControls = require(playerModule).controls
defaultControls:Disable()

local character: Model? = nil
local humanoid: Humanoid? = nil
local root: BasePart? = nil
local held: { [Enum.KeyCode]: boolean } = {}
local jumpHeld = false
local jumpRequested = false
local focused = true
local wasEnabled = false
local yaw = 0
local pitch = Config.CameraPitch
local distance = Config.CameraDistance
local connections: { RBXScriptConnection } = {}

local function connect(signal: RBXScriptSignal, callback)
	table.insert(connections, signal:Connect(callback))
end

local studyMotor: Humanoid? = nil
local studyMotorEnabled = true

local function restoreStudyMotor()
	if studyMotor then
		studyMotor.EvaluateStateMachine = studyMotorEnabled
		if studyMotorEnabled and studyMotor.Health > 0 then
			studyMotor:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
		end
		studyMotor = nil
	end
end

local function clearInput()
	table.clear(held)
	jumpHeld = false
	jumpRequested = false
end

local function controlsEnabled(): boolean
	return focused and not GuiService.MenuIsOpen and Input:GetFocusedTextBox() == nil
		and player:GetAttribute("F1ControlsEnabled") ~= false
		and humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function attachCharacter(model: Model)
	restoreStudyMotor()
	character = model
	humanoid = nil
	root = nil
	clearInput()
	local nextHumanoid = model:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
	local nextRoot = model:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
	if character ~= model or not nextHumanoid or not nextRoot then
		return
	end
	assert(nextHumanoid:IsA("Humanoid") and nextRoot:IsA("BasePart"), "Character parts have unexpected types")
	humanoid = nextHumanoid
	root = nextRoot
	nextHumanoid.AutoRotate = false
	nextHumanoid.AutoJumpEnabled = false
	nextHumanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing, false)
	nextHumanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming, false)
	local _, initialYaw = nextRoot.CFrame:ToOrientation()
	yaw = initialYaw
	pitch = Config.CameraPitch
end

connect(player.CharacterAdded, attachCharacter)
connect(player.CharacterRemoving, function(model: Model)
	if character == model then
		restoreStudyMotor()
		character = nil
		humanoid = nil
		root = nil
		clearInput()
	end
end)
if player.Character then
	task.spawn(attachCharacter, player.Character)
end

connect(Input.WindowFocusReleased, function()
	focused = false
	clearInput()
end)
connect(Input.WindowFocused, function()
	focused = true
end)
connect(GuiService.MenuOpened, clearInput)
connect(Input.TextBoxFocused, clearInput)
connect(player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("F1ControlsEnabled"), clearInput)

Actions:BindActionAtPriority("F1Movement", function(_, state, input)
	if state == Enum.UserInputState.End then
		held[input.KeyCode] = nil
	elseif state == Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
		clearInput()
	elseif state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin and controlsEnabled() then
		held[input.KeyCode] = true
	end
	return if controlsEnabled() then Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink else Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
end, false, Enum.ContextActionPriority.High.Value, Enum.KeyCode.W, Enum.KeyCode.A, Enum.KeyCode.S, Enum.KeyCode.D)

Actions:BindActionAtPriority("F1Jump", function(_, state)
	if state == Enum.UserInputState.Cancel or state == Enum.UserInputState.End then
		jumpHeld = false
	elseif state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin and controlsEnabled() then
		local current = humanoid
		local grounded = current ~= nil and current.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
		jumpRequested = Movement.pressJump(jumpHeld, true, grounded)
		jumpHeld = true
	end
	return if controlsEnabled() then Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink else Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
end, false, Enum.ContextActionPriority.High.Value, Enum.KeyCode.Space)

connect(Input.InputChanged, function(input, processed)
	if not processed and controlsEnabled() and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
		distance = math.clamp(distance - input.Position.Z * Config.CameraZoomStep, Config.CameraMinDistance, Config.CameraMaxDistance)
	end
end)

connect(RunService.PreSimulation, function(dt)
	local currentHumanoid, currentRoot = humanoid, root
	if not currentHumanoid or not currentRoot then
		return
	end
	local studyMode = if PhysicsStudy then currentRoot:GetAttribute("F2StudyMode") else nil
	local studyInput = if PhysicsStudy then currentRoot:GetAttribute("F2StudyInput") else nil
	if studyMode ~= "client" and studyMode ~= "server" then
		restoreStudyMotor()
	end
	if not controlsEnabled() and studyMode == nil and typeof(studyInput) ~= "Vector3" then
		clearInput()
		currentHumanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
		currentHumanoid.Jump = false
		return
	end
	local x = (if held[Enum.KeyCode.D] then 1 else 0) - (if held[Enum.KeyCode.A] then 1 else 0)
	local z = (if held[Enum.KeyCode.S] then 1 else 0) - (if held[Enum.KeyCode.W] then 1 else 0)
	local direction = Movement.direction(x, z, yaw)
	if typeof(studyInput) == "Vector3" then
		direction = studyInput
	elseif not controlsEnabled() then
		direction = Vector3.zero
	end
	if PhysicsStudy and (studyMode == "client" or studyMode == "server") then
		if studyMotor ~= currentHumanoid then
			local motorEnabled = currentRoot:GetAttribute("F2StudyMotorEnabled")
			if typeof(motorEnabled) ~= "boolean" then
				return
			end
			restoreStudyMotor()
			studyMotorEnabled = motorEnabled
			studyMotor = currentHumanoid
		end
		currentHumanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
		currentHumanoid:Move(direction, false)
		currentHumanoid.Jump = false
		jumpRequested = false
		if studyMode == "client" then
			currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = PhysicsStudy.steer(currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity, direction, dt)
		end
		return
	end
	local grounded = currentHumanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
	currentRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(currentRoot.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
	-- shortcut: ordinary Humanoid air control only; add knockback ownership in F2.
	currentHumanoid:Move(direction * (if grounded then 1 else Config.AirControl), false)
	currentHumanoid.Jump = (jumpRequested or (PhysicsStudy ~= nil and currentRoot:GetAttribute("F2StudyJump") == true)) and grounded
	jumpRequested = false
end)

local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
raycastParams.IgnoreWater = true
raycastParams.RespectCanCollide = true
RunService:BindToRenderStep("F1Camera", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
	local enabled = controlsEnabled()
	Input.MouseBehavior = if enabled then Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter else Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
	Input.MouseIconEnabled = not enabled
	if not enabled or not wasEnabled then
		clearInput()
	end
	wasEnabled = enabled
	local currentRoot = root
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera or not currentRoot then
		return
	end
	if enabled then
		local delta = Input:GetMouseDelta()
		yaw = (yaw - delta.X * Config.CameraSensitivity) % (math.pi * 2)
		pitch = math.clamp(pitch - delta.Y * Config.CameraSensitivity, Config.CameraMinPitch, Config.CameraMaxPitch)
	end
	local excluded: { Instance } = {}
	for _, other in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if other.Character then
			table.insert(excluded, other.Character)
		end
	end
	raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
	local focus = currentRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, Config.CameraFocusHeight, 0)
	local rotation = CFrame.fromOrientation(pitch, yaw, 0)
	local offset = -rotation.LookVector * distance
	local hit = workspace:Spherecast(focus, Config.CameraRadius, offset, raycastParams)
	if hit then
		offset = offset.Unit * math.max(0.05, hit.Distance - Config.CameraWallPadding)
	end
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(focus + offset, focus)
	camera.Focus = CFrame.new(focus)
end)

script.Destroying:Connect(function()
	restoreStudyMotor()
	for _, connection in connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	Actions:UnbindAction("F1Movement")
	Actions:UnbindAction("F1Jump")
	RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("F1Camera")
	defaultControls:Enable()
	Input.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
	Input.MouseIconEnabled = true
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera then
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
		if humanoid then
			camera.CameraSubject = humanoid
		end
	end
end)
